behavior: Actual absent-table Pooling remains distinct from a present empty table. Closed live/saved source variants bind the same actual borrow and preserve optional layout without inventing a table, global index or inference grant.

The stateless branch consumes the existing joint sampling/native engine with mandatory complete-source registration. Sampler, operand and uncopied source health validate atomically; complete pins live in the native scope through settlement or quarantine. No decoder table or decoder host scope is created.

Nonzero stateless mechanism tests exercise exact and one-byte-short admission, independent saved duplication, both retirement orders, raw aliases, different-source rejection and typed failure after real key copying.

Dense initialization derives count and source identity from the actual borrowed table. A private worker fills one fixed-capacity Vec<D>, preserves partial ownership and boxes only at exact completion. Managed D=n*sizeof(D), P=D+2*sizeof(D) for nonempty filling; empty and ZST logical counts remain exact.

RetainedStorage::include_array uses cold metadata facts, validates/deduplicates before retaining, and uses a closed safemlx inspection clone only when needed. Query/clone failures precede inventory mutation; lazy backing remains unknown and native error sources are preserved.

Inspection clones use the existing private native lock without evaluation, polling, housekeeping or unrelated owner reclaim. The ordinary Array Clone contract is unchanged; no general callback or new unsafe operation is exposed.
review_findings: Every current Rust file exactly matches its reviewed applied stage hash; all 13 terminal log hashes and test summaries were independently checked before record preparation.
Two cache test result lines contain interleaved CoreAnalytics diagnostics and a following standalone ok; the parser associates those results and reconciles all 154 with the harness summary.
Twelve tests execute twice under overlapping native filters. The record preserves both execution totals and distinct package/binary/test identities.

An off-tree inspection draft used the public release-only submission-retirement callback. Review rejected that boundary before application; the recorded version uses a purpose-built safe inspection clone within safemlx.
The separate stage reviews were written before central validation; this record resolves their pending test status for the exact frozen applied versions without rewriting those reviews.
limits: This is a managed component payload result with the existing descriptor, handle, allocator and planner bookkeeping exclusions; it is not a total process or system memory bound.

Dense initialization alone is not funded live-state construction. Fresh request-bound host protection, atomic protected-hold to actual-table charge transfer, decoder installation, controller/input construction and new step authority remain unfinished; funded native resume still rejects before installation.
Stateless native tests use the established authenticated host-only sampler fixture and actual Metal copy facts. They do not fabricate complete model inference admission.
The current model fixture still has unknown retained lazy rotary helpers. Cold retention does not materialize those helpers or weaken the truthful model publication/admission gate.

Hybrid nested tables, paged state, selected prediction-state copies and the complete facade/controller/ingress payload matrix remain unfinished. No whole-family support is inferred from this storage component.

Snapshot-to-retained-handle association assumes a settled source with no external mutation. Inspection cloning retains native graph/backing ownership, not immutable contents, completion or future execution authority.
No new released-checkpoint, distributed hardware or total-process peak-memory measurements were performed.
